definition_quote.value: The examination, diagnosis, treatment and management of diseases, injuries and disorders of the eye and associated structures, as well as identification of related systemic conditions affecting the eye without the use of invasive surgery or tissue-altering lasers; and the provision, replacement or duplication of an ophthalmic lens without a written prescription
definition_quote.quote: The examination, diagnosis, treatment and management of diseases, injuries and disorders of the eye and associated structures, as well as identification of related systemic conditions affecting the eye without the use of invasive surgery or tissue-altering lasers

methods_authorized.quote: The examination, diagnosis, treatment and management of diseases, injuries and disorders of the eye and associated structures, as well as identification of related systemic conditions affecting the eye without the use of invasive surgery or tissue-altering lasers

drug_authority.value: Licensed optometrists (at therapeutic advanced glaucoma and therapeutic advanced levels) may use, prescribe and dispense therapeutic pharmaceuticals including schedules III, IV and V controlled substances for ocular conditions; may administer injections for emergency treatment of anaphylactic shock; may not prescribe schedules I and II controlled substances, drugs administered exclusively by injection (other than anaphylaxis), oral chemotherapeutic, immunosuppressive or immunostimulant agents.
drug_authority.quote: An optometrist who holds a therapeutic advanced glaucoma license may dispense drug samples at no charge and may use and prescribe any therapeutic pharmaceutical, for ocular conditions including for the treatment of glaucoma. An optometrist with a therapeutic advanced glaucoma license may prescribe any drug identified in schedules III, IV and V

surgery_definition.quote: without the use of invasive surgery or tissue-altering lasers
